name: Hanan Motawie
bio: Hanan Karam Motawie is an Egyptian television and film actress. She is the daughter of Soheir Al Morshedy and the late actor Karam Motawie. She graduated from Cairo University from the faculty of commerce. She began her career on "Hadeeth El Sabah we el Masaa." She's played a number of memorable characters in both television and film, including "Qas we Lazq" by Hala Khalil, "Al Ghaba" (The Forest) and "Heliopolis" by Ahmad Abdalla. She won Best Supporting Actress for her performance in the film "Qas we Lazq." Her television credits include "Sara," "Awlad El Shawarea," "Aghla men Hyati," "Azmet Sokkar" and "Wekalet Ateyya."

credits.overview: Before Spring is a film that tackles the three months prior to the Egyptian Revolution of 2011, with special emphasis on the reasons and motives that sparked it as well as the general state of affairs that prompted the youth to revolt.
